meta.name: AI Content Creator Marketplace — demo seed
meta.disclaimer: All creators, AI personas, brands, clients, reviews and prices in this file are FICTIONAL demo data created for a prototype. Any resemblance to real people or businesses is coincidental. Third-party tool names are used only to describe workflows. Placeholder media comes from loremflickr.com / picsum.photos (stills), api.dicebear.com (avatars) and Google's public sample videos.

searchConfig.howToUse: Normalise the query (lowercase, strip punctuation, treat hyphens as spaces). Find every domain keyword and specialization keyword that appears as a whole word or phrase in the query. Score each creator with the weights below, sort descending, and show the top results with a 'why this matched' label. If fewer than 6 creators score above 0, fill with the nearest matches (same specialization or any shared domain) and say so. Apply the virtualInfluencerBoost only if the creator also shares a detected domain (or no domain was detected). Never show an empty state for a query that maps to a known domain.
searchConfig.geminiQueryUnderstanding: Optional: send the raw query to Gemini (server side) to return JSON {domains[], specializations[], languages[], tools[], wantsAIInfluencer, budgetMaxUSD}. Merge with the keyword result. If Gemini fails or is slow (>2.5s), use the keyword result only.
